milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron ore cluster is at spawn-relative (8-9, 0-1, 8-9), center approximately (8, 1, 8). max_distance=6 ensures the player must walk toward the ore (from spawn distance ~11.3, they need to close to within 6 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the ore, confirming visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a cauldron (7 iron ingots in U-shape on crafting table) results in the cauldron item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with exactly 7 iron ingots and a crafting table is available at spawn-relative (3, 0, -3). The crafted cauldron is not in starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='block' because brown stained glass panes drop nothing when mined without Silk Touch enchantment, making inventory_has impossible. Instead, we verify block removal from the placement area. Originally 6 panes are placed at spawn-relative (-6 to -4, 0-1, 5). The generous bounding box (-8 to -2, -1 to 3, 3 to 7) encloses all panes. max_count=5 means at least one pane must be removed, confirming the player mined it.
